verbalization: The visible evidence suggests a potential relationship between CID 21778290 and SF-188 through a series of target interactions. CID 21778290 is identified as a target of two compounds, Javanicoside F and Astersaponin F, both of which are known to interact with the Dual serine/threonine and tyrosine protein kinase. This kinase is subsequently targeted by SF-188, indicating a possible pathway through which CID 21778290 may be involved in the regulation of SF-188. The scores from the two paths, while not perfectly aligned, suggest a consistent pattern of interaction, with CID 21778290 acting as a mediator in the targeting of SF-188 via these kinase targets. The evidence supports a mechanistic link, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated.
